newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Bezeq Q3 profit down 9 pct - SGST.
newsitem.headline: Bezeq Q3 profit down 9 pct - SGST.

text.p: Societe Generale Strauss Turnbull (SGST) said on Friday that Bezeq Israel Telecom's 1996 third quarter net profit was 148.95 million shekels, down nine percent from the same period in 1995.
Bezeq spokesmen, who said the company's third quarter results would only be released on Sunday, refused to comment on the report.
SGST, in its daily report on the Israeli market, said Bezeq's net profit in Q3 for 1996 was 148.95 million shekels versus 163.73 in 1995.
It said revenues for the quarter were up, at 2.05 billion shekels compared to 2.01 billion shekels in 1995.
It said Bezeq's operating profit for the quarter was 395.66 million shekels compared to 438.41 million shekels in 1995.
The state-owned Bezeq has gone through a difficult period, seeing its monoply on telephone service gradually whittled away.
On Tuesday, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, who took office in June after winning May elections, said Bezeq was on a list of state companies slated for privatisation in 1997.

Israeli Communications Minister Limor Livnat said this week first talks were held with the chief executive of Cable & Wireless Plc on privatising Bezeq. The British company has a 10 percent stake in Bezeq.

Israel's former Labour-led government and Cable & Wireless had failed to reach an agreement on future pruchases of Bezeq by the British firm and the possibility of it becoming a strategic partner in Israel's main telecommunications company.
